meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 它会按这份指南排查容器化 agent 的问题:读主机日志与 setup 日志,查两个 session 数据库判断消息是否送达、是否产出了回复,并检查挂载、心跳和常见故障。
howto.when: 当消息收发不正常、容器启动失败或退出、出现认证问题时触发,也可用于了解容器系统如何运作。

say.text: 机器人突然不回消息了,帮我查日志找出原因
say.note: 会读主机错误日志和消息流

say.text: 消息到了容器却一直没回复,帮我看看卡在哪
say.note: 会查 inbound 和 outbound 两个数据库

say.text: 报 401 认证错误,帮我确认密钥注入模式
say.note: 会检查 OneCLI 的密钥模式

howto.what_en: It follows this guide to debug containerized agents: reading host and setup logs, querying the two session DBs to see if messages arrived and replies were produced, and checking mounts, heartbeats and common failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when messages aren't working, a container fails, there are authentication problems, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The bot stopped replying — check the logs and tell me why
say_en.note: Reads host error log and message flow

say_en.text: The message reached the container but no reply came; find where it stalled
I'm getting a 401 auth error; check the secret mode
